    # horizontally mirrored about the center; recover each masked cell from
    # its reflected cell in the same row, then return just the patch.
    cells = [(r, c) for r, row in enumerate(grid) for c, value in enumerate(row) if value == 8]
    if not cells:
        return []
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, _ in cells), max(r for r, _ in cells)
    c0, c1 = min(c for _, c in cells), max(c for _, c in cells)
    return [[grid[r][len(grid[0]) - 1 - c] for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)]
            for r in range(r0, r1 + 1)]
"
